question: Which of the following is NOT included in UNESCO'S list of World Heritage Sites in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anand Bhavan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anand Bhavan** is not included in UNESCO's list of World Heritage Sites in India.
 
• UNESCO's World Heritage Sites in India include **Sanchi, Bhimbetka, and Khajuraho** among others.
 
• The World Heritage Sites are places of importance to cultural or natural heritage as described in the UNESCO World Heritage Convention.
 
• Anand Bhavan is a historic house museum in Allahabad, India, which was the ancestral home of the Nehru family.
 
• It is not recognized as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO but holds significant historical importance within India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India are selected based on their cultural, historical, and natural significance.
 
• India has a rich heritage with many sites being recognized globally for their importance and preservation.
 
• Some prominent World Heritage Sites in India include the Taj Mahal, Qutub Minar, and the Red Fort Complex.
 
• These sites not only reflect India's historical and cultural wealth but also attract numerous tourists from around the world.
